propositions: Installing rebar from source via pipx fails when host uv is older than 0.9.17 (e.g. 0.7.18), reporting that pipx needs uv>=0.9.17.
The failure is a host pipx/uv toolchain mismatch, not a rebar packaging defect.
The workaround is to run pipx install with --backend pip on the local path form '<path>[agents]'.
A troubleshooting callout documenting the observed error and workaround is added to README.md's '### From source' section.
No package metadata or runtime behavior changes; the change is docs-only.
